frontMatter.title: Weekly Round-Up: 13 Matches Played, Big Wins & Cup Drama
frontMatter.summary: A busy week of 13 matches featuring strong away wins, hard-earned draws, and dramatic cup ties—now it’s on to 14 fixtures next week across Meath League, Dublin League, and the Meath Cup.

prev.title: Meath U17's Shine at Leinster Intercounty Finals
prev.summary: Meath won Division 1 silver with the Meath U17 A team, and bronze with the Meath U17 B at the Leinster U17 Intercounty Finals in Baldoyle.

next.title: Monday Club Night + Cup Match: Navan ‘B’ vs Kildalkey
next.summary: Monday Club Night with a Grade 6 Ladies cup match (Navan ‘B’ vs Kildalkey), two member courts from 8:30pm, and Juvenile Club sessions for girls (6:30pm) and boys (7:30pm).
